title: How to spot a fake natty: massive skeletal changes past puberty
summary: NH gives a fake-natty indicator: rapid facial and skeletal changes after puberty. GH can enlarge hands, feet, nose and joints, while androgens square the face, enlarge the jaw and neck and even widen the cranium, and these changes coincide with sudden gains and regress when use stops. Natural masculinization, by contrast, takes years.
claims: He prefers giving general concepts for spotting fake naturals over calling out individuals, which only creates profit-driven drama
GH can enlarge wrists, ankles, knees, hands, feet and nose even past puberty
Moon face from high estrogen and fat/water retention is a common giveaway of PED use
Androgens masculinize the face: the head squares up, jaw muscles and neck grow, and the sides of the cranium can visibly bulge
Some men are born with a 'warrior skull' (jaw as wide as the cranium) versus a 'wimp skull'; PED users can transition into the former and lose it later
A face that suddenly fills out and squares while strength and size jump, then shrinks back when they stop, is a strong sign of PED use
Natural facial masculinization happens slowly over years with age, testosterone and muscle gain; he had a baby face for a long time that gradually improved
